en: Sepia-toned historic street view labeled "Oschatz — Dresdner Straße." The image shows a broad unpaved street lined with multi‑story buildings on the right and trees and houses on the left. Horse-drawn carriages and a few pedestrians are visible. In the background, prominently rising above the town's rooftops, is a large church with two tall spires. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century European town scene.
